content.text:
A ready hold now waits on the pickup shelf for 10 days instead of 7. All 59 tests pass.

- **The change:** `PICKUP_DAYS` in `lib/holds/pickup.js` went from 7 to 10. The hold-ready notice and the expiry run both read the deadline from there, so they follow automatically. The deadline still moves to the next day the branch is open. For example, a hold that becomes ready on 2026-11-19 now has a deadline of Monday 2026-11-30, because 2026-11-29 is a Sunday and Central is closed.
- **Tests:** I updated `test/holds.test.js`. The deadline test is renamed "for 10 days" and its expected dates are changed. I also added a hold that became ready exactly 10 days ago. It still has today as its last pickup day, so it must not expire. Under the old 7-day rule it would have expired.

The earlier command that combined the edit with `npm test` was denied, so I made the edits with the Edit tool and ran the tests separately. I haven't committed anything.
